question: In Team IS1007, one member said they would check the prices of components. Who was it, what total did they report for a version with all the functions, and what did the team then decide about the LCD?

steps.answer: Speaker C (industrial designer) checked component prices and reported that a version with all functionalities would cost about $15 total to produce. After reviewing this and marketing data showing low consumer interest in LCD, the team decided in the final meeting to drop the LCD (and speech recognition) to keep the remote simple and cheaper.
